name: ChainSwap MappingToken receive() unauthorised signatories
summary: The bridge's receive(fromChainId,to,nonce,volume,Signature[]) counted the supplied signature entries towards its threshold without checking that each signatory was an authorised bridge signer, so anyone could mint bridged tokens to themselves.
notes: ProxyFactory productImplementations('MappingToken') changed from 0xdcb4d17894bd508c0d00b6ddf00ea60e413ef98b to 0xe92998f47118335ba33d1eba87282584f53519b5, the implementation selected by the product proxy at the incident.

Forty nonzero mint events beginning with the anchored transaction created exactly 20,000,000 WYLD for the attacker. The attacker sold that full amount in transaction 0x6fcc98a9a765ed2fb6992e099a0a13fe65c46901dbbf0401a76c2edb4a70b3e2 for exactly 652.443795985428055167 WBNB, the exact BSC liquidity loss measured by this row.
The 652.443795985428055167 WBNB loss was realized by the liquidation transaction 5,388 seconds after the first mint anchor; its USD value uses CoinGecko's nearest pre-anchor WBNB price.
